changes.evidence: Amador's S.H.I.E.L.D. service ended in 2006, when she was captured on a raid on Vanchat's gulag and presumed dead. For the seven years before 'Eye-Spy' (AoS episode 4) she was held and forced to work through the eye implant. In the episode she is already a 'former' agent: she is freed from the implant and taken into S.H.I.E.L.D. custody, which is not a rejoin. So S.H.I.E.L.D. is backstory only.

Po is a former Marine who 'fell off the grid in '08', years before his first episode ('The Bridge', AoS episode 10). The wiki lists the USMC as 'formerly'. In S1 he works only for the Clairvoyant's Centipede Project, a HYDRA operation. The USMC stage is backstory. With it removed, the duplicate HYDRA bookend collapses to Centipede then HYDRA.

Brannis served in the Soviet 478th Rifle Division in WWII and was declared dead in 1944 at Finow. Then he joined Leviathan. Agent Carter shows his Soviet service only as backstory, which Dooley uncovers in episode 4. In S1 he is a Leviathan operative turned 'independent businessman' selling Stark's nitramene.

owner_calls.question: Is Leviathan also backstory for Brannis? By his first scene he has already double-crossed Leviathan and is selling Stark's tech on his own.
options: Keep [[Leviathan, Agent Carter S1], [Independent, Agent Carter S1]] (betrayal treated as part of the S1 story)
Use groups [] (Leviathan membership and the betrayal both happen before episode 1)
owner_calls.evidence: The wiki says Leviathan sent Brannis to rob Stark's vaults, but he 'betrayed his employers and became an independent businessman' before episode 1, where he sells nitramene to Spider Raymond while a Leviathan assassin hunts him.

owner_calls.question: Should Donnie's S2 relapse be recorded? He is brainwashed into HYDRA at the Sandbox, breaks free and hides in Morocco (refusing HYDRA's agents), then is re-triggered by Bakshi in AoS S2 episode 3.
options: [[S.H.I.E.L.D., S1], [HYDRA, S1], [Independent, S2], [HYDRA, S2]] (S1 Independent stage only reflects his custody, which isn't a move)
owner_calls.evidence: Wiki: at the Sandbox, Gill was trained and 'brainwashed into working for the new Hydra', and used to take the Sandbox during the Hydra Uprising (S1). Then he 'managed to break free of his brainwashing and fled' to Morocco and killed the HYDRA agents sent to bring him back. On the Maribel del Mar, Bakshi 'successfully activate[d] Donnie's trigger' (episode 'Making Friends and Influencing People').

owner_calls.question: Should Agatha get a Stark Pictures stage? The wiki lists Stark Pictures as her affiliation, and the episode ends with her giving up the Celestial power to join Kingo in the movie business for real.
options: [[Stark Pictures, What If...?]] (or the season title the owner uses)
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia: 'Kingo convinces Harkness to give up the Celestial power in favor of joining him in the movie business for real.' The MCU wiki infobox affiliation is 'Stark Pictures'.
